name: business
description: Business skills for selling software: regional pricing that recommends a local price per country for each paid product (subscriptions, one-time and in-app purchases), from a digital price index built on mainstream subscriptions, a purchasing-power cross-check, the closest competitors' local prices, each market's natural price endings, a floor and each store's rules, with every number sourced and dated. Recommends only; never changes live prices.
